## Libraries
```{r library}
options(java.parameters = "-Xmx30000m")
set.seed(100)
required_Packages_Install <- c("dplyr", "patchwork", "Seurat","ggplot2")
for(Package in required_Packages_Install){
  if(!require(Package,character.only = TRUE)) { 
    install.packages(Package, dependencies=TRUE)
  }
  library(Package,character.only = TRUE)
}
```
## Loading data
I've renamed features.tsv to genes.tsv for Read10X() to work.
```{r data loading}
data_raw <- Read10X(data.dir = "/Users/ladislavbucek/Desktop/UK/Mgr./labgenexp/refractory/STAR/refractory-12-hpaSolo.out/data/raw/filtered")
```
### QC

```{r QC}
data_obj  <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = data_raw, project = "ravi_0_hpa_B", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

data_obj <- AddMetaData(object = data_obj, metadata = 12, col.name = "hpa")
data_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(data_obj, pattern = "^mt-")


VlnPlot(data_obj, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)


plot1 <- FeatureScatter(data_obj, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") +
    scale_y_continuous(                  # Set y-axis range from 0 to 100%
        breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10),        # Major ticks every 10%
        minor_breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 1)    # Minor ticks every 1%
    )+
    theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray",  linewidth = 0.25)  # Display minor grid lines
    )
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(data_obj, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")+
    scale_y_continuous(                  # Set y-axis range from 0 to 100%
        breaks = seq(0, 15000, by = 1000),        # Major ticks every 10%
        #minor_breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 1)    # Minor ticks every 1%
    )+
    theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray",  linewidth = 0.25)  # Display minor grid lines
    )
plot1 + plot2
data_obj <- subset(data_obj, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 10000 & percent.mt < 24)
```
## Normalization 
Using log normalization.

```{r norm}
data_obj <- NormalizeData(data_obj, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
```

## Feature selection 


```{r feature selection}
data_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(data_obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(data_obj), 10)
```

## Data scaling 

```{r data scaling}
all.genes <- rownames(data_obj)
data_obj <- ScaleData(data_obj, features = all.genes)
#head(data_obj)
```
## PCA UMAP
```{r PCA}
data_obj <- RunPCA(data_obj)
ElbowPlot(data_obj, ndims = 50)
data_obj <- FindNeighbors(data_obj, dims = 1:30 , reduction = "pca")
data_obj <- FindClusters(data_obj, resolution = 2, cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters")
data_obj <- RunUMAP(data_obj, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")

cluster_labels_m <- levels(data_obj)

cluster_colors_m <- Polychrome::createPalette(length(cluster_labels_m), c("#ff0000", "#00ff00", "#0000ff"))
names(cluster_colors_m) <- cluster_labels_m

DimPlot(data_obj, reduction = "umap.unintegrated" )+
    scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors_m) +
    theme_minimal() +
    ggtitle("UMAP")
```
